thread:
anna: Helix trial call in 15m. Theyre seeing slow TTFT on tiny prompts (~10-20 tokens) using rw-instruct-13b-8k hosted in us-west-2. Reported p50 ~650ms, p95 ~1s. Asking for quick fixes and cost estimate.

sam_engineer: Are they streaming? small prompts + non-streaming often show kernel startup cost. Also need sample headers to confirm prefill flag reached server.

anna: Non-streaming. Example request they shared: curl POST /v1/generate with prefill_tokens=4 and stream=false. No custom batching headers.

lee_infra: Looking at telemetry for their route: p50 batch size = 1, KV cache hit rate ~10%. Lots of short-lived sessions -> cache miss and extra setup. No 429s.

lee_infra: Quick mitigations: 1) ask client to enable client-side bundling or parallelize RPCs, 2) temporarily enable server-side prefill and small batching delay on their route.

toni_support: Cost note: prefill_tokens=4 => +4 billed input tokens per RPC. At their demo peak (~100 req/min) that's ~24k extra tokens/hr. On hosted pricing that's small for short demo. I'll calculate precise $ and DM them.

sam_engineer: Also check if route has prefer_latency. That disables some batching. Switching to prefer_throughput or setting batching_delay_ms=10-20ms helps batch formation.

lee_infra: I rolled a 10% canary: route flag allow_server_prefill=true and batching_delay_ms=15. Deploy-bot: canary c-22499 started.

deploy-bot: canary rollout applied -> id c-22499 -> route=helix-trial -> 10% traffic.

lee_infra: Canary early numbers: p50 -> 300ms (was 650ms), p95 -> 520ms (was ~1s). Batch p50 increased to 2. KV hit rate up to ~48% in canary.

anna: Great. Helix asked whether this will change billing or SLA if we keep it on permanently.

toni_support: Billing unchanged: tokens billed normally. If they want committed capacity (Dedicated) for guaranteed p95, that's a separate contract + monthly commit. I'll prepare a one-pager comparing: hosted+prefill (low cost, small token overhead, best-effort latency) vs Dedicated (higher fixed cost, predictable low p95).

sam_engineer: Short-term POC runbook to send Helix:
- Keep client prefill_tokens=4.
- Set batching_delay_ms=15 via header or SDK.
- We keep canary for 24h, monitor p95 and cache hits.
- If stable, promote config and add to account notes.

anna: I'll run the call and share the runbook. Who owns the procurement note?

toni_support: I will. I'll include estimated extra token cost for their current peak and side-by-side p95 numbers.

lee_infra: I'll leave the canary running and post an update in 1h. Ping me if you want raw logs.

anna: Thanks team, going into the call now. :thumbsup:
